title: Puzzle 3D Vortex Arrow Preview
description: Render puzzle 3D vortices as a small point sphere plus a directional arrow, with a per-window option to draw arrows outwards (tip away from the point) or inwards (tip on the point).
summary:
Brought Flow play app to board-app chrome parity.

- DAG engine: grid visible/snap/factor with LOD-tiered painting, drag snap, focus_selection_camera API, and tests.
- Flow core: grid setters on FlowHost, extended flow_backed_node_graph_extras lod_json (gridVisible, gridSnapEnabled, gridFactor), default proximity 48.
- WGPU + node-graph surfaces: sync grid fields from lod_json.
- Flow plugin: window_measures rail (LOD, proximity slider, grid group); removed canvas settings from empty inspector; palette actions selectAll/focusSelection with mod+a; context menu select-all / zoom-to-selection / delete; internal actions marked in_palette:false; procedural plugin callers updated.

Tests: infinite_board_port_directed_dag (grid snap, focus selection), flow-plugin (23 tests), flow_core extras.
